signal_overrides.notes: Accelerator Position; validated through dynamic DID F301.
Generator Revolution (MG1); validated through dynamic DID F301.
Motor Revolution (MG2); validated through dynamic DID F301.
FR Wheel Speed; pilot rolling range 0..71.41 km/h, with four-wheel correlations >=0.99 and MG2/road-speed correlation 0.9998.
FL Wheel Speed; pilot rolling range 0..71.55 km/h, with four-wheel correlations >=0.99 and MG2/road-speed correlation 0.9998.
RR Wheel Speed; pilot rolling range 0..71.16 km/h, with four-wheel correlations >=0.99 and MG2/road-speed correlation 0.9998.
RL Wheel Speed; pilot rolling range 0..71.42 km/h, with four-wheel correlations >=0.99 and MG2/road-speed correlation 0.9998.
Steering Angle; correlated with repeated stationary steering nudges.
Stop Light Switch; correlated with brake-pedal contact.
Brake Cancel Switch; exact threshold remains pending.
Master Cylinder Control Torque; pilot road range -874.25..0 Nm and nonzero only with braking indications. This is request/control, not physical pad contact.
Requested MG regenerative torque; pilot rolling range -264..0 Nm, request/execution correlation 0.9987, and braking-state association observed.
Executed MG regenerative torque; pilot rolling range -264..0 Nm, request/execution correlation 0.9987, and braking-state association observed.
Engine Mode; raw state 3 throughout stationary qualification and the powertrain road batch; enum meaning remains unverified.
Target Engine Revolution; varied plausibly from 934 to 2775 rpm; independent engine-speed reference pending.
Target Engine Power; pilot range 0..50380 W and correlation 0.9109 with executed engine power.
Execute Engine Power; pilot range 0..56660 W and correlation 0.9109 with target engine power.
Target Generator Torque; pilot range -57.625..0 Nm and target/actual correlation 0.9965.
Generator Torque; pilot range -56.5..1.375 Nm and target/actual correlation 0.9965.
Generator Carrier Frequency; raw states 3..5 observed, with enum and physical-frequency mapping pending.
Generator Control Mode; raw states 0 and 2 observed; enum mapping pending.
Generator Inverter Operation Request; raw state 4 was constant in stationary and road observations; enum mapping pending.
Target Motor Torque; pilot range -88.875..73.875 Nm and target/actual correlation 0.9989.
Motor Torque; pilot range -84.375..75 Nm and target/actual correlation 0.9989.
Motor Carrier Frequency; raw states 1 and 3 observed, with enum and physical-frequency mapping pending.
Motor Control Mode; raw states 0 and 1 observed; enum mapping pending.
Motor Inverter Operation Request; raw state 4 was constant in stationary and road observations; enum mapping pending.
BATT Voltage; varied plausibly from 12.632 to 14.155 V during the pilot road batch.
Hybrid/EV Battery SOC immediately after IG ON; constant 40.5% as expected for an ignition-cycle snapshot.
Hybrid/EV Battery Maximum SOC; rose monotonically from 42.5% to 49.5%, with 14 increments and no decreases.
Hybrid/EV Battery Minimum SOC; constant 39.0%; minimum-accumulator behavior remains plausible but unexcited.
VL before boosting; pilot range 266.5..318.5 V and coherent pairing with boosted-side voltage.
VH after boosting; pilot range 271.5..424.5 V and boost delta up to 117.5 V.
Generator Temperature Sensor Voltage; observed at 3.094..3.104 V with nine raw levels.
Generator Temperature; observed at 52 degC, equal to the recorded maximum and above the 48 degC IG-ON snapshot.
Generator Temperature just after IG ON; constant 48 degC ignition-cycle snapshot.
Generator Maximum Temperature; constant 52 degC and not below current or IG-ON temperature.
Motor Temperature Sensor Voltage; observed at 3.082..3.108 V and inversely associated with the one-degree temperature transition.
Motor Temperature; varied from 51 to 52 degC and remained at or below the recorded maximum.
Motor Temperature just after IG ON; constant 47 degC ignition-cycle snapshot.
Motor Maximum Temperature; constant 52 degC and not below current or IG-ON temperature.
Transaxle Oil Temperature Sensor Voltage; observed at 3.389..3.403 V with 13 raw levels.
Transaxle Oil Temperature; constant plausible 48 degC during the 45-second pilot batch.
Motor Inverter Temperature; varied from 37 to 43 degC and remained below the recorded maximum.
Motor Inverter Temperature just after IG ON; constant 41 degC ignition-cycle snapshot.
Motor Inverter Maximum Temperature; constant 48 degC and above all current/IG-ON observations.
Inverter Coolant Water Temperature; varied plausibly from 38 to 41 degC.
Shift Position; raw state changed from 0 in Park qualification to 6 throughout the road batch; enum labels pending.
Shift Position (Meter); raw state changed from 1 in Park qualification to 8 throughout the road batch; enum labels pending.
Yaw Rate Value; varied from -3.480 to 10.184 deg/s with both signs; synchronized steering reference pending.
Rear MG Activate Condition; remained false in stationary and road observations on this vehicle configuration.
Engine Start Request for battery charging; changed between qualification and road observations; exact trigger pending.
Accelerator Pedal Status; visited both boolean states during the road batch; synchronized analog comparison pending.
MG Activate Condition; remained true in stationary and road observations; inactive reference pending.
Ready Signal; true throughout known READY stationary qualification and road observations.
